en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from one of his companions, from Hammad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘No one is to be imprisoned for ever except for three – One who severely tortures someone, and the woman who reneges from Al-Islam, and the thief (who steals) after the cutting of the hand and the leg’.
